scenes.collision: A Briar wolf wears an Earth security badge and demands the names of every refugee.
scenes.opening: The wolf's badge bears tomorrow's date. Behind him, a child holds a paper boat over the river and refuses to say where her family sleeps. Vesper recognizes the handwriting on the patrol map: their own, from before the betrayal.

choices.label: Ask two neighbors to witness a nameless crossing.
choices.cost: The crossing slows while witnesses assemble; the patrol learns the route exists.
choices.outcome: The wolf counts the witnesses instead of the children. Vesper tears the address column from the register and gives it to the families to burn.
choices.callback: A negotiated-world ending can preserve anonymous passage under community oversight.

choices.label: Give the patrol a decoy route and escort the families yourself.
choices.cost: Vesper risks repeating the copied-map betrayal; the bridge remains unprotected.
choices.outcome: The wolf runs toward a street that no longer exists. Vesper guides the families across, then leaves the decoy map with a neighbor who can expose the trick.
choices.callback: A separated-world ending records the rescued families and the danger of an ungoverned route.

choices.label: Refuse the register and wait for a public ferry.
choices.cost: The families spend the night in the cold; the patrol keeps its post.
choices.outcome: At dawn, the ferryman accepts names spoken only to the river. Vesper pays for the delay with their own safe passage.
choices.callback: The final crossing remembers that refusal can protect privacy without making travel easy.

scenes.fallback: If no earlier Hoshimori witness was earned, the child and ferryman can still corroborate the crossing. No mandatory fragment depends on the prior witness.

scenes.landmark: Red Oven, now opening onto the royal tide gate
scenes.collision: A mermaid tide gate has made childhood memories the Oven's fuel.
scenes.opening: Bread comes out of the Oven stamped with names no one consented to share. Pip has counted the hungry twice; Char can hear the tide behind the firebrick. Vesper sees the same impossible bargain as the map they once sold: safety bought with someone else's address.

choices.label: Ration ordinary bread and open the crossing in shifts.
choices.cost: Some travelers wait through another tide; the Oven cannot feed everyone at once.
choices.outcome: Pip chalks a queue on the floor. No one is asked for a memory, and the hungry choose their own place in line.
choices.callback: Finale shelter records a slow, consent-preserving evacuation.

choices.label: Rebuild the Oven's pact with revocable, volunteered memories.
choices.cost: The Oven loses half its capacity; volunteers can withdraw at any time.
choices.outcome: Char strikes the old names from the brass grate. Each volunteer speaks a memory and keeps the right to take it back. The first loaf is small, but nobody disappears from the record.
choices.callback: Shared-world endings inherit a revocable consent charter, not compulsory sacrifice.

choices.label: Put out the Oven and carry the hungry through the side passage.
choices.cost: The village loses its warm refuge until repairs are made.
choices.outcome: Vesper closes the flue. Pip shoulders the flour sacks and leads the first group into the cold, where the ferryman waits with a lantern.
choices.callback: Separated-world endings acknowledge the lost refuge and a community repair obligation.

scenes.fallback: The side passage is always reachable. Neither Char's survival in the original timeline nor any optional e07/e08 success is required to finish.

state_contract.choice_policy: Exactly one choice per scene, irreversible on replay.
state_contract.fragment_policy: Each scene grants one unique e12 memory fragment only after a valid choice; never on visit.
state_contract.save_policy: Persist chosen IDs and earned fragments atomically; reloading may display the selected outcome but must not grant again.
state_contract.forgery_policy: Unknown choice IDs, unvisited scenes and missing earned e12 entry reject without mutation.
state_contract.ending_policy: Callbacks use earned effects only; never infer a hinge decision from an absent flag.
